iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

LSN::disable
       LSN::disable

SYNOPSIS
       LSN::disable

DESCRIPTION
       Disables LSN translation for the current connection if LSN translation has been configured.

       Arguments:
	   LSN::disable - If LSN translation is configured, disables translation for this connection.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       AUTH_RESULT AUTH_WANTCREDENTIAL CACHE_REQUEST CACHE_UPDATE CLIENT_ACCEPTED CLIENT_DATA CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT
       CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE HTTP_CLASS_FAILED HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED HTTP_REQUEST HTTP_REQUEST_DATA LB_SELECTED RTSP_REQUEST
       RTSP_REQUEST_DATA SIP_REQUEST MR_INGRESS STREAM_MATCHED

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    LSN::disable
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.3.0
	   - Initial version where the command was introduced

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
